items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: Joe Pass was telling me years ago about that.

ctx.x: Joe Pass was telling me years ago about that. And from my point of view, I’m not American. It happened that I am French and so European, but I’ve seen the way so many concerts, and the way that jazz has been always loved and protected in Europe. It makes me logical to have the opportunity, and thank you for that, to speak to my brother American musicians about somewhere — we are on the same train on a different car. I will put it this way. But to me that train, call it the A train if you want.
Yeah, it goes to the same direction, yeah.
